hypotheses.oneSentenceStory: Leo views all partner reward balances in a single, clear interface and reviews transfer options explained in plain English.
hypotheses.customerSituation: Leo holds rewards across three separate partner programmes and wants to see them together without confusing terminology.
hypotheses.storyTension: Fragmented balances across multiple partners and complex transfer rules create friction and confusion.
hypotheses.customerResolution: A unified wallet view clearly displays total holdings and simplifies partner transfers using plain English.
hypotheses.primaryOutcome: Understand and manage combined reward balances and transfer options easily in plain English.
completionSignals: Explored partner transfer option with plain-English guide
